title: EnvGenProposal
description: A PROPOSED (not applied) sizing configuration for the idea-board platform. The LLM proposes values; this schema plus the hard guardrails in main.py validate them; a human then reviews the rendered tfvars / Helm-values snippet before anything is applied. The vocabulary is deliberately CONSTRAINED to the cloud-agnostic t-shirt sizes so the same proposal maps identically onto AWS (EKS/RDS) and GCP (GKE/Cloud SQL).

node_size.description: Cloud-agnostic node t-shirt size. Each cloud module maps it to a concrete machine type (AWS: t3.medium/m5.large/m5.2xlarge; GCP: e2-medium/e2-standard-4/e2-standard-8).

node_count.description: Number of worker nodes in the cluster node pool.

backend_replicas.description: Baseline replica count for the FastAPI backend Deployment (Helm key backend.replicas).

frontend_replicas.description: Baseline replica count for the nginx frontend Deployment (Helm key frontend.replicas).

hpa_min.description: Backend HorizontalPodAutoscaler minimum replicas (Helm key hpa.min).

hpa_max.description: Backend HorizontalPodAutoscaler maximum replicas (Helm key hpa.max). Must be >= hpa_min.
